latest_release.body:
# OpenStock v2026.10.25

OpenStock is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) alternative to paid market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights without a paywall. Use it at https://openstock-ods.vercel.app or self-host it with every feature.

This release covers everything on `main` up to #140. The previous tag was [`v2026.10.18`](https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock/releases/tag/v2026.10.18) ("October update"); the full history, with per-release credits, is on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog).

## What OpenStock does today

- **Markets:** a dashboard for US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories; ⌘K search across every exchange Finnhub covers; stocks open as tabs.
- **Stock pages:** TradingView charts with drawing tools and fullscreen (#118, #45), indicators that stay on every chart (#119), financials, technicals, company profile, and sentiment insights (#64). International tickers map correctly to TradingView (#57, #65, #117).
- **Watchlist and alerts:** a watchlist of up to 50 stocks (#127), price alerts by email in realtime mode, and a weekly AI-written news digest.
- **Accounts:** email and password sign-in, password reset (#71), live password requirements (#79), rate-limited auth, and a reset that signs out other devices (#125, #126).
- **AI providers:** Gemini, with MiniMax as an alternative provider (#61) and Siray.ai fallback (#40).
- **Self-hosting:** Docker and Docker Compose (#17), builds that need no database or secrets (#123), MongoDB kept private in Compose (#124), a prebuilt GHCR image on Node 22 (#128), one-click deploys on RepoCloud, ZopDay and Railway (#111, #115, #94), and an env checker (#104).
- **Community:** a changelog that credits every contributor (#130, #131), a Wall of love, and an in-app update banner (#129).

## New since v2026.10.18

- **Dividend yield card** on stock pages, using real Finnhub data, with a dash for stocks and crypto without a dividend. #137 (@samki6576)
- **Public, crawlable pages:** `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are reachable signed-out, plus public, server-rendered company and guide pages (`/s`, `/compare`); the signed-in `/stocks/[symbol]` app is unchanged. #136
- **MiniMax defaults to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** when `MINIMAX_MODEL` is unset, for primary requests and fallback; explicit overrides still work. #140 (@octo-patch)
- **Docker realtime mode works again:** `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE` is passed as a build arg, so Docker and Railway self-hosters can switch to realtime. #134
- **Dependency upgrades:** better-auth 1.3.25 → 1.7.10 (#132); nodemailer 7.0.6 → 10.1.2 and `@types/nodemailer` dropped, removing 81 packages from the lockfile (#133).
- **Docs and project health:** README rewritten to match how OpenStock works today (#135), Contributor Covenant 2.1 Code of Conduct (#139), FLOSS/fund funding manifest (`funding.json`) (#138).

#134 and #135 merged on 18 Oct 2026; #132, #133 and #136–#139 merged on 19 Oct 2026; #140 merged on 21 Oct 2026 (IST).

## Thank you

Everyone whose pull requests were merged into OpenStock:

@ravixalgorithm @keshav-005 @octo-patch @akoweicollinxx @chinnsenn @nb-src @CrixusWen @TPTBusiness @alexander-schneider @Bortlesboat @Chukwuebuka-2003 @kuishou68 @BambaSatoru @Yi-111-a @cosark @muskanbandta23 @cosmind-rusu @samki6576

People whose issues led to fixes are credited per release on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog).

OpenStock stays free thanks to sponsors: [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/ravixalgorithm) · [sponsor page](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/sponsor).

**[Open OpenStock](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app)** · [Changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog) · [Self-host it](#self-hosting) · [Sponsor](#sponsors) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/JkJ8kfxgxB)
# OpenStock **Markets, minus the paywall.** OpenStock is a free, open-source alternative to expensive market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights. Use it at [openstock-ods.vercel.app](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app), or run your own copy with every feature. > ❤️ **13,000+ people use OpenStock for free.** Help keep it that way: [sponsor from $5 a month](https://github.com/sponsors/ravixalgorithm/sponsorships?frequency=recurring&amount=5), or read [how OpenStock is funded](#sponsors). > [!NOTE] > OpenStock is community-built and not a brokerage. Market data may be delayed depending on the provider and your setup. Nothing here is financial advice. ## 📋 Table of Contents 1. 🔋 [Features](#features) 2. ⏱️ [How fresh is the data](#data-freshness) 3. ⚙️ [Tech stack](#tech-stack) 4. 🤸 [Quick start](#quick-start) 5. 🔐 [Environment variables](#environment-variables) 6. 🐳 [Self-hosting](#self-hosting): Docker, prebuilt image, one-click deploys, Vercel 7. 🧱 [Project structure](#project-structure) 8. 📡 [How it works](#data--integrations) 9. 🌍 [Market support](#market-support) 10. 🧪 [Scripts and tests](#scripts--tooling) 11. 🤝 [Contributing](#contributing) 12. 🏆 [Contributors](#contributors) 13. 🛡️ [Security](#security) 14. 📜 [License](#license) 15. 🌱 [Open Dev Society manifesto](#manifesto) 16. 🙏 [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) 17. ❤️ [Sponsor OpenStock](#sponsors) ## 🔋 Features **Markets** - A dashboard for eight markets: US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Saudi Arabia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, a sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories. - Search every exchange Finnhub covers with **⌘K**, and keep stocks open as browser-style tabs. **Stock pages** - TradingView candles with drawing tools (trend lines, Fibonacci, shapes, text) and fullscreen. - Pick indicators once (SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, ATR) and they stay on every chart. - Financials, technicals and the company profile. - Sentiment from Reddit, X, news and Polymarket (with an Adanos key). **Watchlist and alerts** - A watchlist of up to 50 stocks, saved to your account. - Price alerts above or below a target, checked every 5 minutes and emailed to you (in realtime mode). - A weekly, AI-written news digest by email every Monday. **Accounts** - Email and password, plus Google and GitHub sign-in when configured; password reset and a profile page. - Rate-limited sign-in, sign-up and password reset; resetting your password signs out your other devices. **Community** - A [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog) that credits everyone who contributed, a [Wall of love](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/love), and an update banner in the app. ## ⏱️ How fresh is the data Charts always stream live from TradingView. Quotes, watchlist prices and alerts come from Finnhub: | | Quotes | Price alerts | Cost | |---|---|---|---| | **Community**: [openstock-ods.vercel.app](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app) | Every hour, shared by everyone | No | Free | | **OpenStock Cloud** (coming soon) | Every 15 seconds | By email | $5 a month | | **Self-hosted** | Every hour, or every 15 seconds with `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime` and your own Finnhub keys | By email, in realtime mode | Free | ## ⚙️ Tech stack | | | |---|---| | App | Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui and Radix | | Accounts and data | Better Auth, MongoDB with Mongoose | | Market data | Finnhub, TradingView widgets, Adanos (sentiment) | | Background jobs | Inngest | | Email | Nodemailer (Gmail), Kit for the newsletter | | AI | Gemini, MiniMax or Siray | | Hosting | Vercel; a Docker image on GitHub Container Registry for self-hosting | ## 🤸 Quick start You need Node.js 22 LTS, a MongoDB database (a free Atlas cluster, or the [Docker setup](#docker-setup)) and a free [Finnhub](https://finnhub.io) key. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git cd OpenStock npm ci cp .env.example .env # fill in MONGODB_URI, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and FINNHUB_API_KEY node scripts/check-env.mjs # checks your .env npm run test:db # checks the MongoDB connection npm run dev # http://localhost:3000 ``` Welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest run as [Inngest](https://www.inngest.com) jobs. Locally, start Inngest's dev server alongside the app: `npx inngest-cli@latest dev`. For production: `npm run build && npm start`. ## 🔐 Environment variables Every variable is listed with comments in [`.env.example`](.env.example). The ones that matter: | Variable | Needed | What it's for | |---|---|---| | `MONGODB_URI` | Yes | Your MongoDB database | | `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` | Yes | Signs sessions. Generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Auth refuses to run in production without it | | `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | Yes | The app's public URL, used for auth callbacks and links in emails | | `FINNHUB_API_KEY` | Yes | Market data. Or put several free keys, comma-separated, in `FINNHUB_API_KEYS`: they're rotated, and each adds 60 requests a minute | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE` | No | `cached` (hourly, the default) or `realtime` (every 15 seconds, with price alerts). Fixed when the app is built: rebuild after changing it | | `INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY`, `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` | In production | Background jobs: welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest | | `NODEMAILER_EMAIL`, `NODEMAILER_PASSWORD` | No | Sending email through Gmail, with an app password. Without them, emails are skipped | | `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or MiniMax or Siray) | No | AI-written welcome emails and the news digest | | `ADANOS_API_KEY` | No | The sentiment card on stock pages | | `KIT_API_KEY`, `KIT_API_SECRET`, `KIT_WELCOME_FORM_ID` | No | The weekly digest newsletter in Kit | | `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `_SECRET`, `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` / `_SECRET` | No | Social sign-in. Callbacks: `/api/auth/callback/google` and `/github` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_FINNHUB_API_KEY` still works as a name for the Finnhub key. No key is ever sent to the browser. ## 🐳 Self-hosting ### Docker Compose Runs OpenStock and MongoDB together. MongoDB is only reachable inside the Docker network; it isn't published on your machine. 1. Fill in `.env` (see above). For the bundled database, choose a password and use it in both places. Letters and digits are simplest; `@ : / ? #` must be percent-encoded in the URI. ```env MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD=change-me MONGODB_URI=mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin ``` 2. Start it: `docker compose up -d --build` 3. Open http://localhost:3000 The image build needs no secrets: every variable is read when the container starts, except `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE`, which Compose passes to the build from `.env`. Data lives in the `mongo-data` volume, and the MongoDB password is only applied when that volume is first created. ### Prebuilt image Every push to `main` publishes `ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock` for amd64 and arm64, tagged `latest`, `sha-`, and a version for each release (for example `2026.10.18`). To use it, replace `build:` under `openstock` in `docker-compose.yml` with: ```yaml image: ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock:latest ``` then run `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. The prebuilt image runs in cached mode; build it yourself for realtime. ### One-click deploys [![Deploy on RepoCloud](https://d16t0pc4846x52.cloudfront.net/deploylobe.svg)](https://repocloud.io/details/OpenStock/) [![Deploy to ZopDay](https://zop.dev/deploytozopday-inkhard.svg)](https://zop.dev/zopday/app/deploy?repo=https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock&port=3000&name=openstock&utm_source=github&utm_medium=one_click&utm_content=openstock) [![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/openstock-1?utm_medium=integration&utm_source=template&utm_campaign=generic) ### Railway OpenStock ships a [`railway.json`](railway.json) that builds the `Dockerfile`, checks health on `/sign-in` and restarts on failure. The template above sets everything up; to do it by hand: 1. Create a project and add a **MongoDB** database (`+ New → Database → MongoDB`). 2. Add a service from this repository (`+ New → GitHub Repo`). 3. In the service's **Variables**, set: ```env MONGODB_URI=${{MongoDB.MONGO_URL}} BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${{secret(32)}} BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://${{RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}} FINNHUB_API_KEY=your_finnhub_key GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY=your_inngest_signing_key INNGEST_EVENT_KEY=your_inngest_event_key NODEMAILER_EMAIL=youraddress@gmail.com NODEMAILER_PASSWORD=your_gmail_app_password ``` 4. Under **Settings → Networking**, generate a public domain and redeploy. For background jobs, add your Railway domain as an app in the [Inngest dashboard](https://app.inngest.com), pointing to `https:///api/inngest`. To turn on realtime mode, also set `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime`; Railway passes it to the build. ### Vercel Import the repository, set the variables above for Production, and connect Inngest (its Vercel integration sets both keys). [`vercel.json`](vercel.json) pins functions to Mumbai (`bom1`), next to the hosted database; change it to the region nearest yours. ## 🧱 Project structure ``` app/ (marketing)/ public pages: landing, about, help, api-docs, sponsor, love, changelog, terms, /s/[ticker], /compare (auth)/ sign-in, sign-up, forgot-password, reset-password (root)/ the signed-in app: dashboard, watchlist, stocks/[symbol], profile api/ auth/[...all] (Better Auth), inngest (background jobs), quotes (live prices) components/ shell/ (sidebar, tabs), stocks/, watchlist/, landing/, marketing/, sponsors/, forms/, ui/ (shadcn) database/ MongoDB connection and models (watchlist, alert) lib/ actions/ server actions: auth, profile, watchlist, alerts, Finnhub, sentiment better-auth/ auth setup (connects to MongoDB on first use, so builds need no database) inngest/ background jobs and AI prompts nodemailer/ email sending and templates markets.ts the dashboard's markets market-data.ts cached vs realtime changelog.ts releases and contributor credits sponsors.ts sponsors and tiers rate-limit.ts MongoDB-backed limits for auth and live quotes middleware.ts public marketing, /s and /compare pages; app pages redirect to sign-in scripts/ check-env.mjs, test-db.mjs, and one-off maintenance scripts __tests__/ Vitest tests ``` ## 📡 How it works - **Finnhub**: search, quotes, company profiles and news. Responses are cached and shared (for an hour, or 15 seconds in realtime mode), with timeouts and a key pool, so a slow upstream never hangs a page. - **TradingView**: the chart, heatmap, financials, technicals and profile widgets. - **Adanos** (optional): the sentiment card. - **Better Auth with MongoDB**: accounts and sessions. Pages and server actions check the session on the server; the middleware only redirects signed-out visitors. - **Inngest** runs the background jobs: | Job | When | |---|---| | AI-personalised welcome email | On sign-up | | Price alert check | Every 5 minutes, in realtime mode | | Weekly news digest (a Kit broadcast) | Mondays at 09:00 UTC | - **Email**: Nodemailer (Gmail) sends welcome, alert and password-reset emails; Kit sends the weekly digest. ## 🌍 Market support | Market | Charts (TradingView embeds) | Quotes, watchlist prices, alerts (Finnhub free) | |---|---|---| | 🇺🇸 United States | Live | Yes | | Crypto (Binance pairs) | Live | Yes | | Forex | Live | No | | 🇨🇦 Canada, 🇦🇺 Australia | Delayed | No | | 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia (Tadawul) | Blocked; delayed Yahoo Finance quotes instead | No | | 🇮🇳 India (BSE; `.NS` symbols chart on BSE), 🇩🇪 Germany | End of day | No | | London, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Korea and others | Candles blocked; financials, technicals and profile work | No | The full table, and why some markets are limited, is in [MARKET_SUPPORT.md](MARKET_SUPPORT.md). ## 🧪 Scripts and tests | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `npm run dev` | Development server (Turbopack) | | `npm run build`, `npm start` | Production build and server | | `npm test` | Vitest tests (`npm run test:watch` to keep watching) | | `npm run lint` | ESLint | | `npx tsc --noEmit` | Type check. Builds skip type errors, so run this before opening a PR | | `npm run test:db` | Checks the MongoDB connection | | `node scripts/check-env.mjs` | Checks your `.env` | ## 🤝 Contributing You belong here. Whether you're a student, a self-taught dev or a seasoned engineer, contributions are welcome. 1. Pick a [good first issue](https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22), or open an issue to talk about an idea or a bug first. 2. Fork the repo, branch from `main`, then `npm ci` and `cp .env.example .env`. 3. Keep the pull request focused: a test for new logic, a screenshot for UI changes. 4. Before you open it, run `npm test`, `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint`. Every merged pull request, and every issue that leads to a fix, is credited on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog) and below. Be kind, guide beginners, no gatekeeping: that's the Open Dev Society way. Participation is covered by the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). ## 🏆 Contributors OpenStock is built by everyone below: the people who wrote the code and the people whose issues led to a fix. Every release, and who made it happen, is on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog#contributors). [@ravixalgorithm](https://github.com/ravixalgorithm) founded and maintains OpenStock, and built it from the ground up: authentication, UI design, API and AI integration, and deployment.
